lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high overall, though several major winning changes (such as sign_in redesign in r6, choose_path redesign in r10, adoption new_flow in r12, adoption incentive in r13, choose_path copy in r14, finish redesign in r15, and adoption redesign in r16) were underpredicted.
Sign-in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 10 tests (rounds 1, 7, and 15), while the remaining 7 showed no clear effect or slight negative results.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 2 of 10 tests (rounds 13 and 14), while the remaining 8 showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes consistently failed to produce positive results, showing no clear effect or hurting performance across all 3 tests with zero wins.
Redesigns across adoption, finish, and sign-in categories frequently hurt performance or showed no clear effect, despite occasional isolated wins.

Evidence remains thin or outcomes are mixed for single-test categories and small categories with conflicting results (such as adoption new_flow, adoption incentive, choose_path copy/layout, and home notifications).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Grid Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend screen with a grid layout featuring live animated companion choice cards for faster selection.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops significantly to 70.7% completion; a visual grid layout helps users pick pets faster.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Pet Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend to live on your desktop and keep you company while you work.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick_friend with a grid layout while maintaining the screen's core job and required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff at adoption step, but adoption redesigns average -1.7% across 6 historical tests.

candidates.title: Companion Personality Trait Flow
candidates.change: Add a companion personality selection screen during adoption where users choose pet behavior traits before issuing the certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 70.7%, and post-onboarding support shows confusion around pet interactions.

new_personality_select.headline: Define Your Pet's Personality
new_personality_select.body: Choose how playful, vocal, or active your companion will be on screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new personality selection screen inside onboarding without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Support mail and funnel support addressing adoption, but adding new flow steps usually increases friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Controls Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro with a split layout explaining key shortcuts for hiding, summoning, and talking to your pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step drops to 72.5%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Quick Guide: Click pet to interact, press Alt+P to hide/show, or right-click for controls menu.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro within onboarding without breaking any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support tickets and finish dropoff, but finish redesigns average negative returns (-0.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Render Verification Screen
candidates.change: Insert a render verification screen after loading to ensure the desktop pet properly spawned before completing setup.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported the pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to display after setup.

new_render_check.headline: Verifying Desktop Visibility
new_render_check.body: Can you see your pet active on your screen right now?

guard.reason: Adds a render verification screen inside onboarding while keeping all required steps intact.

candidates.score_note: Addresses reported render issues, but introducing new screens consistently fails across past tests (-2.1% avg).

candidates.title: Story Intro Companion Overview Copy
candidates.change: Update story screen headline and body text to clearly describe how desktop pets assist and interact daily.
candidates.why: The choose_path mean duration is 514s; clearer early narrative helps users choose their journey without long hesitation.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Companion
story.body: Adopt a digital pet that wanders on screen, reacts to your workflow, and keeps you energized all day.

guard.reason: Updates story copy while continuing to introduce the desktop pet.

candidates.score_note: Target step dropoff is low, but choose_path copy changes have a positive track record (+0.8% avg) at zero dev cost.

candidates.title: Account Pet Save Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit hint text on the sign_in screen confirming that account login protects pet customization data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pet traits, adoption record, and custom settings permanently in the cloud.

guard.reason: Adds helpful safeguard hint text to the sign_in screen without violating any constraints.

candidates.score_note: 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff provide strong evidence; sign_in hints are proven winners (+1.6% avg, 3 wins).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Stamp Incentive
candidates.change: Add a unique collector badge component and completion perk text on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption completion rate drops to 70.7%; adding completion rewards encourages users to finish adoption.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate Granted
adoption_certificate.hint: Adopting completes your starter profile and unlocks bonus desktop animations!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions unlocking bonus desktop animations, violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning free extras, gifts, or perks.

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Ready Companion Wait Info
candidates.change: Update waiting screen status headline and step progress explaining engine initialization details.
candidates.why: Home step median time is 201s (mean 2336s); detailed engine status reassures users during initialization.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Pet Animation Engine...
waiting.body: Preparing desktop workspace shaders, sound effects, and pet behaviors.

guard.reason: Updates waiting screen status details while continuing to communicate that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long home step wait times; wait_info changes have a solid track record (+1.4% avg, 2 wins).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Ready System Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification toggle on waiting screen so users get alerted when pet render finishes.
candidates.why: Users wait a median of 201s on home; system notifications bring back tabbed-out or idle users.

waiting.hint: We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet arrives on screen.

guard.reason: Adds notification toggle on the waiting screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at home step idle times, but home notifications historically yield negative relative change (-0.3% avg across 7 tests).

candidates.title: Compact Layout Desktop Welcome Overview
candidates.change: Switch home_intro layout to compact mode with interactive checklist for pet controls.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 72.5%; concise compact layouts reduce cognitive load before entering main desktop app.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro layout to compact mode while keeping the required onboarding step.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high dropoff (27.5% loss); layout changes in finish showed positive early promise (+4.2%).
